payload.text: hv, 2026-10-27, directly to vc in vc's session, on ic's hold 17 (the menu's arngz link): 'Ah, now I understand. Yes, of course. And that should be true of all of the ~/bin/* links that are linked to a hardcoded dev install location, rather than using whatever use has set up.'
